verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents API access tokens, an official CLI (ldcli), and official local and hosted MCP servers, so the UI's capabilities are clearly reachable programmatically to a meaningful degree. However, no evidence states that the API matches the UI feature for feature, and probes found no OpenAPI spec at the standard paths. missing for 10: an explicit API-parity or API-first statement, a discoverable published API spec covering all UI features (targeting, approvals, experiments, roles), and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.
